The '''speed scooter''' was a type of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] during the early part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Unlike most traditional aerodynamic speeder bikes, the speed scooter was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] while sitting in a seat with an upright back.
